title: Discomfortable
summary: DISCOMFORTABLE, adjective 1. Causing uneasiness; unpleasant; giving pain; making sad. [Little used.] 2. Uneasy; melancholy; refusing comfort. [Not used.] [Instead of this word, uncomfortable is used.]
